Amid rising tension in India over #HMPV cases, Karnataka and Tamil Nadu govt has advised people to wear masks in public places as precaution. So far, 7 people tested positive of HMPV virus, 2 from #Karnataka, 2 from #TamilNadu, 2 from #Maharashtra and 1 from #Gujarat.
